scheme_name: BPL (Below Poverty Line) Student Welfare Scholarship - Technical Education
other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular student in a government engineering or polytechnic institution in Chhattisgarh.
Applicant must not be receiving benefits from any other scholarship.
Scholarship is subject to satisfactory academic progress and regular attendance of the student.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly scholarship of ₹1,000 for B.E. students and ₹500 for diploma students, payable for up to 10 months per academic year.
